body:
PRE-EDIT TYPE CHECKPOINT on assigned bd-01M15XZ290HDMPTA4NXP88G4CM: the same case-class escape exists one level above the requested receipt, in PopulationAggregate itself. This is source-proven, not javap speculation: in alignJVM/console on current main, `PopulationAggregate.fromProduct((null.asInstanceOf[SourceView], Vector.empty[SubjectAlignment]))` compiles and returns PopulationAggregate(null,Vector()). That bypasses PopulationAggregate.of, admitting both an empty population and an unchecked view/proof combination. javap also exposes public fromProduct/unapply/_1/_2 and Product. The private case-class constructor is therefore not a smart-construction boundary.

This is the exact failure class behind the chief warning, in the same reserved population.scala and PopulationSuite paths, but changing Aggregate from case class to final non-case class is a public shape change beyond the literal receipt wording. Recommendation: include it now, retain public read-only view/subjects and structural equals/hashCode, make construction private to of, give it an intentional non-payload toString, and add external/source-level negative probes for fromProduct/Product/unapply plus the requested PopulationReceipt doors. Alternative: file a separate immediate bead and leave this candidate narrower. Chief: please rule before I edit; the three assigned receipt/error/name changes are otherwise fully scoped.
